About me

I work in hospitality because I like the floor — the pace of a busy service, a regular who comes back, a guest who leaves happier than they arrived. In Malta I have worked as a waiter in Sliema, Paceville and beyond, and I am currently on the team at The Brew Grill & Brewery in Sliema.

Before Malta, I built my foundation in Bangladesh in customer service and sales — including a customer service officer role at Popular Diagnostic Centre and a sales executive role with PRAN-RFL Group. That mix means I am as comfortable handling a complaint or a till as I am carrying a section of tables.

Alongside work, I am studying for an MBA in Human Resource Management in Malta. It shapes how I work with a team: reliable, respectful, and easy to roster. I am now looking for my next full-time or part-time role in the Sliema–Valletta area.

What I do

Three sides of the same job — looking after guests well, whether they are at a table, at the coffee bar, or at the front desk.

Table service

Running a section through a full service: greeting and seating guests, taking orders accurately, timing courses with the kitchen, and keeping tables looked after without being intrusive.

Barista & bar support

Espresso-based coffees made consistently and served with care, plus bar-assistant work — restocking, glassware, garnishes and keeping the bar clean and ready through a shift.

Front desk & customer service

A welcoming first point of contact: answering questions, handling bookings and requests, resolving problems calmly, and managing payments and enquiries at the desk or by phone.
